items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as an Object.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为 Object。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a Date object.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为 Date 对象。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a Time object.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为 Time 对象。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a Timestamp object.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为 Timestamp 对象。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a BigDecimal object.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值，并将其作为 BigDecimal 对象返回。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a boolean.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为布尔值。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a byte.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为字节。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a Double object.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为 Double 对象。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a float.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为浮点数。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as an int.
items.translation: 检索当前行中指定列的值作为 int。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a long.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为 long 类型。

items.source:
Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a String
(for NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR columns).
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为字符串（针对 NCHAR、NVARCHAR 和 LONGNVARCHAR 列）。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a short.
items.translation: 获取当前行中指定列的值作为 short 类型。

items.source: Retrieve the value of the indicated column in the current row as a String.
items.translation: 检索当前行中指定列的值作为字符串。

items.source: Uses of InvalidResultSetAccessException in org.springframework.jdbc.support.rowset
items.translation: `org.springframework.jdbc.support.rowset` 中 `InvalidResultSetAccessException` 的用法

items.source: Create a new ResultSetWrappingSqlRowSet for the given ResultSet.
items.translation: 为给定的ResultSet创建一个新的ResultSetWrappingSqlRowSet。

items.source: Report whether the last column read had a value of SQL NULL.
items.translation: 报告最后读取的列的值是否为 SQL NULL。

items.source: Provides a convenient holder for disconnected result sets.
items.translation: 提供用于存储已断开连接的结果集的便捷容器。

items.source: Move the cursor to the given row number in the row set, just after the last row.
items.translation: 将光标移动到行集给定的行号处，即最后一行之后的位置。

items.source: Move the cursor to the end of this row set.
items.translation: 将光标移至此行集的末尾。

items.source: Move the cursor to the front of this row set, just before the first row.
items.translation: 将光标移至该结果集的最前端，即第一行之前的位置。

items.source: Map the given column label to its column index.
items.translation: 将给定的列标签映射到其列索引。

items.source: Move the cursor to the first row of this row set.
items.translation: 将光标移动到此行集的第一行。

items.source:
Retrieve the catalog name of the table that served as the source for the
specified column.
items.translation: 检索指定列所源自表的目录名称。

items.source: Retrieve the fully qualified class that the specified column will be mapped to.
items.translation: 获取指定列将映射到的完全限定类。

items.source: Retrieve the number of columns in the RowSet.
items.translation: 获取 RowSet 中的列数。

items.source: Retrieve the maximum width of the designated column.
items.translation: 检索指定列的最大宽度。

items.source: Retrieve the suggested column title for the column specified.
items.translation: 检索指定列的建议列标题。

items.source: Retrieve the column name for the indicated column.
items.translation: 获取指定列的列名。

items.source: Return the column names of the table that the result set represents.
items.translation: 返回结果集所代表的表的列名。

items.source: Retrieve the SQL type code for the indicated column.
items.translation: 检索指定列的 SQL 类型代码。

items.source: Retrieve the DBMS-specific type name for the indicated column.
items.translation: 检索指定列的特定于 DBMS 的类型名称。

items.source: Retrieve the precision for the indicated column.
items.translation: 检索指定列的精度。

items.source: Retrieve the current row number.
items.translation: 获取当前行号。

items.source: Retrieve the scale of the indicated column.
items.translation: 检索指定列的标度。

items.source:
Retrieve the schema name of the table that served as the source for the
specified column.
items.translation: 检索指定列所源自表的模式名称。

items.source:
Retrieve the name of the table that served as the source for the
specified column.
items.translation: 检索指定列所源自的表名。

items.source: Retrieve whether the cursor is after the last row of this row set.
items.translation: 检索游标是否位于此行集的最后一行之后。

items.source: Retrieve whether the cursor is before the first row of this row set.
items.translation: 检索游标是否位于此行集的第一行之前。

items.source: Indicate whether the case of the designated column is significant.
items.translation: 指明指定列的大小写是否重要。

items.source: Indicate whether the designated column contains a currency value.
items.translation: 指示指定列是否包含货币值。

items.source: Retrieve whether the cursor is on the first row of this row set.
items.translation: 检索游标是否位于此行集的第一行。

items.source: Retrieve whether the cursor is on the last row of this row set.
items.translation: 检索游标是否位于此行集的最后一行。

items.source: Indicate whether the designated column contains a signed number.
items.translation: 指示指定列是否包含有符号数字。

items.source: Move the cursor to the last row of this row set.
items.translation: 将光标移动到此行集的最后一行。

items.source: Move the cursor to the next row.
items.translation: 将光标移至下一行。

items.source: Move the cursor to the previous row.
items.translation: 将光标移动到上一行。

items.source: Move the cursor a relative number of rows, either positive or negative.
items.translation: 将光标相对移动指定数量的行，可以是正数或负数。
